facts.text: Serve the snacks when Del pulls out his shower curtain rings.
facts.why: Del hands his rings to the rental counter woman in a story he tells, and no scene shows him pulling them out. The waking-up-holding-hands scene is real ('Those aren't pillows').
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Neal and Del wake up holding hands.

facts.text: Del's bag shook it up. Open it carefully.
facts.why: The beer cans burst because Del left them on a vibrating motel bed, not from a shaken bag. Neal complains about sleeping in a puddle of beer.
facts.fix: Shaken on the motel bed. Open it carefully.

facts.text: Del's Chicago order. Those aren't pillows.
facts.why: 'Those aren't pillows' is Neal's real line, but no source shows Del ordering Italian beef. Chicago is where they are headed.
facts.fix: A Chicago bite. Those aren't pillows.

vibe.verdict: A good postcard motel for the pillows and the burnt car, though three claims about Del can't be backed.
missing: Waking up holding hands, 'Those aren't pillows!' (motel)
Neal's rant at the car rental desk (St. Louis airport)
The burnt car and the melted speedometer (the road)
Riding in the refrigerated truck to Chicago (Thanksgiving Day)
